     6|module
     7|
     8|public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Irreducible.Defs
     9|public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.Lattice
    10|public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.Pointwise
    11|public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Submonoid.Basic
    12|public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Defs
    13|public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Basic
    14|public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Monoid.Defs
    15|public import Mathlib.Order.Preorder.Finite
    16|
    17|/-!
    18|# Indecomposable elements of monoids
    19|-/
    20|
    21|@[expose] public section
    22|
    23|open Set
    24|
    25|variable {ι M G S : Type*} [Monoid M] [CommGroup G] [LinearOrder S]
    26|
    27|/-- Given a family of elements of a monoid, a member is said to be indecomposable if it cannot be
    28|written as a product of two others in a non-trivial way. -/
    29|@[to_additive (attr := simp) /-- Given a family of elements of an additive monoid, a member is said
    30|to be indecomposable if it cannot be written as a sum of two others in a non-trivial way.-/]
    31|def IsMulIndecomposable (v : ι → M) (s : Set ι) (i : ι) : Prop :=
    32|  i ∈ s ∧ ∀ᵉ (j ∈ s) (k ∈ s), v i = v j * v k → v j = 1 ∨ v k = 1
    33|
    34|@[to_additive]
    35|protected lemma IsMulIndecomposable.subset (v : ι → M) (s : Set ι) :
    36|    {i | IsMulIndecomposable v s i} ⊆ s := by
    37|  aesop
    38|
    39|@[to_additive]
    40|lemma isMulIndecomposable_id_univ [Subsingleton Mˣ] {x : M} (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    41|    IsMulIndecomposable id univ x ↔ Irreducible x :=
    42|  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨by simpa, by simpa using h⟩, fun h ↦ by simpa using h.isUnit_or_isUnit⟩
    43|
    44|/-- The "base" of a set of points of a monoid relative to a morphism `f`. -/
    45|@[to_additive /-- The "base" of `v` relative to a morphism `f`.
    46|
    47|In the case that `v` is the set of roots of a crystallogrphic root system, and `S = ℚ`, this is the
    48|base of the root system associated to `f`. -/]
    49|def IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf [Monoid S] (v : ι → M) (f : M →* S) : Set ι :=
    50|  IsMulIndecomposable v {i | 1 < f (v i)}
    51|
    52|@[to_additive]
    53|lemma IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf_subset_one_lt [Monoid S] (v : ι → M) (f : M →* S) :
    54|    IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf v f ⊆ {i | 1 < f (v i)} :=
    55|  IsMulIndecomposable.subset _ _
    56|
    57|@[to_additive]
    58|lemma IsMulIndecomposable.image_baseOf_inv_comp_eq [InvolutiveInv ι]
    59|    [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]
    60|    (v : ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹)
    61|    (f : G →* S) :
    62|    v '' baseOf v (invMonoidHom.comp f) = (invMonoidHom ∘ v) '' baseOf v f := by
    63|  suffices ∀ (f : G →* S),
    64|      v '' baseOf v (invMonoidHom.comp f) ⊆ (invMonoidHom ∘ v) '' baseOf v f by
    65|    apply subset_antisymm (this f)
    66|    replace this := image_mono (f := invMonoidHom) <| this (invMonoidHom.comp f)
    67|    rw [← MonoidHom.comp_assoc, invMonoidHom_comp_invMonoidHom, MonoidHom.id_comp, image_comp,
    68|      ← image_comp invMonoidHom invMonoidHom, ← MonoidHom.coe_comp, invMonoidHom_comp_invMonoidHom,
    69|      ← image_comp] at this
    70|    simpa using this
    71|  clear f
    72|  rintro f g ⟨i, ⟨hi, hi'⟩, rfl⟩
    73|  refine ⟨i⁻¹, ⟨by simpa [hv_inv] using hi, fun j hj k hk hi ↦ ?_⟩, by simp [hv_inv]⟩
    74|  replace hi : v i = v j⁻¹ * v k⁻¹ := by
    75|    rwa [hv_inv, inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, mul_inv, ← hv_inv, ← hv_inv] at hi
    76|  specialize hi' j⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv]) k⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv]) hi
    77|  aesop
    78|
    79|/-- Given a finite family of points `v` in a monoid `M`, together with a morphism into a
    80|linearly-ordered monoid `f : M →* S`, the submonoid generated by those points of `v` which lie in
    81|the "half space" where `f > 1` is generated by the subset of such points which are indecomposable
    82|with respect to points in this half space. -/
    83|@[to_additive /-- Given a finite family of points `v` in an additive monoid `M`, together with a
    84|morphism into a linearly-ordered additive monoid `f : M →+ S`, the submonoid generated by those
    85|points of `v` which lie in the half space where `f > 0` is generated by the subset of such points
    86|which are indecomposable with respect to points in this half space.
    87|
    88|If `v` is the set of roots of a crystallographic root system and `S = ℚ`, then this is
    89|[serre1965](Ch. V, §9, Lemma 2) and it may be used to prove that the root system has a base. -/]
    90|lemma Submonoid.closure_image_isMulIndecomposable_baseOf [Finite ι]
    91|    [CommMonoid S] [IsOrderedCancelMonoid S]
    92|    (v : ι → M) (f : M →* S) :
    93|    closure (v '' IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf v f) = closure (v '' {i | 1 < f (v i)}) := by
    94|  refine le_antisymm (closure_mono (image_mono <| IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf_subset_one_lt v f))
    95|    (closure_le.mpr ?_)
    96|  rintro - ⟨i, hi : 1 < f (v i), rfl⟩
    97|  by_contra hi'
    98|  let t : Set ι := {i | IsMulIndecomposable v {j | 1 < f (v j)} i}
    99|  let s : Set ι := {j | 1 < f (v j) ∧ v j ∉ closure (v '' t)}
   100|  have hne : s.Nonempty := ⟨i, hi, hi'⟩
   101|  clear! i
   102|  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := s.toFinite.exists_minimalFor (f ∘ v) s hne
   103|  have ⟨(hi₀ : 1 < f (v i)), (hi₁ : v i ∉ _)⟩ : i ∈ s := hi.prop
   104|  have hi₂ (k : ι) (hk₀ : 1 < f (v k)) (hk₁ : f (v k) < f (v i)) : v k ∈ closure (v '' t) := by
   105|    by_contra hk₂; exact not_le.mpr hk₁ <| hi.le_of_le ⟨hk₀, hk₂⟩ hk₁.le
   106|  have hi₃ : i ∉ t := by contrapose! hi₁; exact subset_closure <| mem_image_of_mem v hi₁
   107|  obtain ⟨j, k, hj, hk, hjk⟩ : ∃ (j k : ι) (hj : 1 < f (v j)) (hk : 1 < f (v k)),
   108|      v i = v j * v k := by
   109|    grind [IsMulIndecomposable]
   110|  have hj' : v j ∈ closure (v '' t) := hi₂ j hj <| by aesop
   111|  have hk' : v k ∈ closure (v '' t) := hi₂ k hk <| by aesop
   112|  replace hjk : v i ∈ closure (v '' t) := hjk ▸ mul_mem hj' hk'
   113|  exact hi₁ hjk
   114|
   115|@[to_additive]
   116|lemma Subgroup.closure_image_isMulIndecomposable_baseOf [Finite ι] [InvolutiveInv ι]
   117|    [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]
   118|    (v : ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹)
   119|    (f : G →* S) (hf : ∀ i, f (v i) ≠ 1) :
   120|    closure (v '' IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf v f) = closure (range v) := by
   121|  rw [← image_univ]
   122|  refine le_antisymm (closure_mono (image_mono <| by simp)) ((closure_le _).mpr ?_)
   123|  have : univ = {i | 1 < f (v i)} ∪ {i | f (v i) < 1} := by ext i; simp [(hf i).symm]
   124|  rw [this, image_union, union_subset_iff]
   125|  refine ⟨le_trans ?_ (le_closure_toSubmonoid (v '' IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf v f)), ?_⟩
   126|  · simp [Submonoid.closure_image_isMulIndecomposable_baseOf]
   127|  · let f' : G →* S := invMonoidHom.comp f
   128|    have h₁ : (invMonoidHom ∘ v) '' IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf v f' =
   129|        v '' IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf v f := by
   130|      rw [image_comp, IsMulIndecomposable.image_baseOf_inv_comp_eq v hv_inv f, image_comp,
   131|        ← image_comp]
   132|      simp
   133|    have h₂ : v '' {i | f (v i) < 1} = v '' {i | 1 < f' (v i)} := by simp [f']
   134|    rw [h₂, ← h₁, image_comp, coe_invMonoidHom, image_inv_eq_inv, closure_inv]
   135|    refine le_trans ?_ (le_closure_toSubmonoid (v '' IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf v f'))
   136|    simp [Submonoid.closure_image_isMulIndecomposable_baseOf]
   137|
   138|namespace IsMulIndecomposable
   139|
   140|@[to_additive]
   141|lemma pairwise_div_notMem_range [InvolutiveInv ι]
   142|    (v : ι → G)
   143|    (hv_one : ∀ i, v i ≠ 1)
   144|    (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹)
   145|    (s t : Set ι)
   146|    (hst : s ⊆ IsMulIndecomposable v t)
   147|    (hv_t : ∀ i, i ∈ t ∨ i⁻¹ ∈ t) :
   148|    s.Pairwise fun i j ↦ v i / v j ∉ range v := by
   149|  have h_sub : s ⊆ t := hst.trans (IsMulIndecomposable.subset _ _)
   150|  intro i hi j hj hne
   151|  by_contra! ⟨k, hk⟩
   152|  rcases hv_t k with hk' | hk'
   153|  · suffices ¬ IsMulIndecomposable v t i from this (hst hi)
   154|    simp only [IsMulIndecomposable, hv_one, or_self, imp_false, not_and, not_forall, not_not]
   155|    exact fun _ ↦ ⟨k, hk', j, h_sub hj, by simp [hk]⟩
   156|  · suffices ¬ IsMulIndecomposable v t j from this (hst hj)
   157|    simp only [IsMulIndecomposable, hv_one, or_self, imp_false, not_and, not_forall, not_not]
   158|    exact fun _ ↦ ⟨k⁻¹, hk', i, h_sub hi, by simp [hv_inv, hk]⟩
   159|
   160|@[to_additive]
   161|lemma pairwise_div_notMem_range' [InvolutiveInv ι] [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]
   162|    (v : ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹)
   163|    (f : G →* S) (hf : ∀ i, f (v i) ≠ 1)
   164|    (s : Set ι) (hst : s ⊆ IsMulIndecomposable v {i | 1 < f (v i)}) :
   165|    s.Pairwise fun i j ↦ v i / v j ∉ range v := by
   166|  have hv_one : ∀ i, v i ≠ 1 := fun i ↦ by contrapose! hf; exact ⟨i, by simp [hf]⟩
   167|  apply pairwise_div_notMem_range v hv_one hv_inv s {i | 1 < f (v i)} hst fun i ↦ ?_
   168|  simpa [hv_inv] using (hf i).symm
   169|
   170|@[to_additive]
   171|lemma pairwise_baseOf_div_notMem [InvolutiveInv ι] [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]
   172|    (v : ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹)
   173|    (f : G →* S) (hf : ∀ i, f (v i) ≠ 1) :
   174|    (baseOf v f).Pairwise fun i j ↦ v i / v j ∉ range v :=
   175|  pairwise_div_notMem_range' v hv_inv f hf (baseOf v f) (.refl _)
   176|
   177|@[to_additive]
   178|lemma mem_or_inv_mem_closure_baseOf [Finite ι] [InvolutiveInv ι] [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]
   179|    (v : ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹)
   180|    (f : G →* S) (hf : ∀ i, f (v i) ≠ 1) (i : ι) :
   181|     v i    ∈ Submonoid.closure (v '' baseOf v f) ∨
   182|    (v i)⁻¹ ∈ Submonoid.closure (v '' baseOf v f) := by
   183|  rw [Submonoid.closure_image_isMulIndecomposable_baseOf v f]
   184|  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hf i) with hj | hj
   185|  · right
   186|    exact Submonoid.subset_closure ⟨i⁻¹, by simpa [hv_inv]⟩
   187|  · left
   188|    exact Submonoid.subset_closure ⟨i, by simpa⟩
   189|
   190|end IsMulIndecomposable
